Venue: Biconomy.com
Headline: 🏆 KCT Trading Competition — Share 19,940,180 KCT!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The KCT Trading Competition is here!
Trade KCT/USDT on Biconomy and compete for a share of the 19,940,180 KCT prize pool!
## 📅Activity time
## November 22 — November 28, 2026 (UTC)
## 📝 How to Participate
1. Create or log in to your Biconomy account
2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade KCT_USDT during the event period
⚠️ You MUST register via the form to be eligible.
## 🏁 Competition Rules
## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible KCT/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative KCT/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled KCT/USDT trades during the campaign.
- Registration via form completed
## 🎁 Prize Distribution (19,940,180 KCT):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume
🥇 1st Place | 4,000,000 KCT | 10,000 USDT
🥈 2nd Place | 2,800,000 KCT | 8,000 USDT
🥉 3rd Place | 1,200,000 KCT | 6,000 USDT
4th-10th Place | Share 5,200,000 KCT by Trading Volume | 3,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 6,740,180 KCT by Trading Volume | 500 USDT
Qualified users will share 19,940,180 KCT based on their trading volume rankings.
Your Reward = (Your Eligible Trading Volume ÷ Total Eligible Trading Volume of All Qualified Users in the Same Ranking Group) × Corresponding Prize Pool
## Notes
1. You MUST register via the form to be eligible.
2. Users will be ranked based on their total eligible KCT/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign period on Biconomy.
3. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
4. Biconomy reserves the right to disqualify accounts involved in wash trading, self-trading, market manipulation, multi-account abuse, or other fraudulent activities. Such trades will not count toward campaign rankings or rewards.
5. Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
